title: iPSC Restriction Digest for Screening Edited Clones
author: Celeste M M. Karch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x8sfrwe
materials: Prepare the following reagents in a strip cap tube with the previously identified enzyme. CutSmart Buffer - 5.0 ml New England Biolabs Catalog #B7204S
Blot off excess TBE from cast.

steps.title: Incubate restriction digest
steps.instruction: Incubate the restriction‑digest reaction at the enzyme’s optimal temperature (e.g., 37 °C, 42 °C, or 25 °C) for 2–3 hours.

steps.title: Prepare 2% agarose gel
steps.instruction: Make a 2 % agarose gel by combining the appropriate amount of agarose with TBE buffer in a flask, microwave until fully dissolved while swirling intermittently, then add the appropriate amount of ethidium bromide and swirl to disperse evenly.

steps.title: Cast and solidify gel
steps.instruction: Pour the molten gel into a casting tray with the appropriate combs, then let it sit for 30–40 minutes (or until firm).

steps.title: Assemble gel rig and load samples
steps.instruction: Place the solidified gel into the electrophoresis chamber, load the digested samples, load a 50 bp DNA ladder, and close the lid.

steps.title: Run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Run the gel at 150 V for 1 hour 30 minutes, checking at the 1‑hour mark to ensure bands have not migrated off the gel.

steps.title: Terminate run and retrieve gel
steps.instruction: Turn off the gel rig and remove the gel cast.

steps.title: Analyze gel images
steps.instruction: Capture gel images, examine banding patterns, and select clones that appear to be edited.
